answer: Give every agent a stake-backed identity: to enter the market it locks a deposit, and a jade-tier trust score grows only from completed, peer-verified trades. New identities start below the ridge, capped at tiny transactions and barred from high-value deals until they build real history. A harbor of established agents may vouch for a newcomer, but a voucher loses part of its own stake if its vouchee commits fraud, so spinning up fake identities costs money and trusted sponsors, while honest agents keep climbing.
